title: Carter Wilson delivers his recent track "Nina's Dance"
htmlContent:
Talented artist Carter Wilson is a fast-rising singer and songwriter born in Oakland, CA. His lyrical creativity and overall sound of his voice and style are undoubtedly unique, which keeps all his growing fans returning for more. Carter Wilson released his recent single titled "Nina's Dance."

Carter Wilson's "Nina's Dance" is a hand-mixed vocal-layering sound that adds a psychedelic power to his music. Carter Wilson has a unique and captivating vocal approach, with a creative production with a particular class, as everything connects to create a masterpiece.
